text: Appeal of Order to Comply for 34 Dixington Crescent.

The Property Standards Committee, Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Order to Comply, dated October 18, 2019, for 34 Dixington Crescent, and in doing so granted an extension of time to April 30, 2022 for Items 1, 2, 4, 5, 6 and 7 only.
